import java.util.*;
import java.math.*;

public class Main {
	 public static void main(String[] args) {
		// TODO Auto-generated method stub
		Scanner s=new Scanner(System.in);
		int n=s.nextInt();
		int k=s.nextInt();
		int[] arr=new int[n];
		int[] arr2=new int[n];
		boolean[] vi=new boolean[n];
		for(int i=0;i<n;i++) {
			arr[i]=s.nextInt();
			arr2[i]=arr[i];
		}
		Arrays.sort(arr2);
		int sum=0;
		ArrayList<Integer>aa=new ArrayList<Integer>();
		for(int i=n-1;i>=(n-k);i--) {
			sum=sum+arr2[i];
			aa.add(arr2[i]);

		}
		System.out.println(sum);
		int cnt=0;
		int flag=0;
		for(int i=0;i<n;i++) {
			if(aa.contains(arr[i])) {
				if(flag==0) {
					aa.remove(new Integer(arr[i]));
					cnt++;
					flag=1;
				}
				else {
					aa.remove(new Integer(arr[i]));
					System.out.print(cnt+" ");
					cnt=1;
				}
			}
			else {
				cnt++;
			}
		}
		System.out.print(cnt);
		
		
		
		
	}

}
